description: This file defines the 'Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo' class, a custom cache resource handler for Smarty that stores cache data into a PDO-supported database, specifically MySQL. It manages cache retrieval, storage, and deletion using SQL statements, enabling caching of Smarty templates in a database.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo
classes.description: A cache resource class for Smarty that stores cache files in a database table using PDO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDO cache handler with a PDO connection, table name, and optional database.

methods.name: fillStatementsWithTableName
methods.description: Populates SQL statements with the actual table name.

methods.name: getFetchStatement
methods.description: Prepares different SQL select statements based on cache identifiers.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves cached content and its modification time from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores cache content into the database with expiration handling.

methods.name: inputContent
methods.description: Encodes content before saving to database (identity function here).

methods.name: outputContent
methods.description: Decodes content after retrieving from database (identity function here).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries from the database based on provided filters.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the correctly formatted table name, including database if specified.
